mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user` WHERE isDelete = 0) AS userCount, COUNT(*) AS pictureCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN reviewStatus = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingReviewCount, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(picSize), 0) AS SIGNED) AS totalPicSize, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(downloadCount), 0) AS SIGNED) AS totalDownloadCount FROM picture WHERE isDelete = 0

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS ( SELECT DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{offsetDays} DAY) AS d UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM date_series WHERE d < CURDATE() ) SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ds.d, '%Y-%m-%d') AS `date`, COUNT(p.id) AS `count` FROM date_series ds LEFT JOIN picture p ON p.createTime >= ds.d AND p.createTime < DATE_ADD(ds.d, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND p.isDelete = 0 GROUP BY ds.d ORDER BY ds.d

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(category), ''), '未分类') AS category, COUNT(*) AS `count`, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(picSize), 0) AS SIGNED) AS totalSize FROM picture WHERE isDelete = 0 GROUP BY category ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, category ASC

SELECT jt.tag AS tag, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM picture p, JSON_TABLE(p.tags, '$[*]' COLUMNS (tag VARCHAR(64) PATH '$')) jt WHERE p.isDelete = 0 AND p.tags IS NOT NULL AND JSON_VALID(p.tags) GROUP BY jt.tag ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, jt.tag ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN reviewStatus = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS approvedCount, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN reviewStatus = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS rejectedCount, COALESCE( ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN reviewTime IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, createTime, reviewTime) END), 0), 0 ) AS averageReviewSeconds FROM picture WHERE isDelete = 0
SELECT id, name, url, downloadCount FROM picture WHERE isDelete = 0 ORDER BY downloadCount DESC, createTime DESC LIMIT #{limit}
